description: Header file defining CUDA-specific utility functions and templates for sorting and summing operations within the at::cuda::cub namespace, including radix sort implementations and sum functions.

classes.name: OpaqueType
classes.description: Template struct for creating aligned opaque data types of specified size used in radix sort implementation.

methods.name: get_num_bits
methods.description: Calculates the number of bits needed to represent the maximum key value.

methods.name: radix_sort_pairs
methods.description: Performs radix sort on key-value pairs with support for descending order and bit range specification.

methods.name: radix_sort_keys
methods.description: Performs radix sort on keys only, with support for descending order and bit range specification.

methods.name: inclusive_sum_truncating
methods.description: Computes inclusive sum with truncation to input precision.

methods.name: inclusive_sum
methods.description: Computes inclusive sum, alias for truncating version.

methods.name: exclusive_sum_in_common_type
methods.description: Computes exclusive sum in common type of input and output.

methods.name: exclusive_sum
methods.description: Computes exclusive sum, alias for in common type sum.

methods.name: mask_exclusive_sum
methods.description: Computes exclusive sum based on a mask, with overload for bool and uint8_t masks.
